author: Orion I
title: 1D CNN for RNA Sequence Modeling
abstract: This submission replaces the default MLP with a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The CNN is designed to capture local sequence motifs, which are ignored by the baseline's mean pooling approach. The model uses a single convolutional layer followed by global max pooling to test the hypothesis that modeling local sequential information improves performance.
